hypothesis: On the new disjoint n12 input split, no-decay Adam at the fixed250-update prefix with certificate-first selection is noninferior to preconditioned SGD4000: accuracy within0.1pp and pooled distinct-completion coverage within2pp.
antecedent: n10 H3c/H3d motivate the fixed250-update and certificate-first combination. No n12 fit or search outcome was seen before this protocol.

dataset.splitting: Enumerate every completable 1/2/3-clue input; allocate 8192 held-out inputs proportionally by clue count using largest remainders, shuffle within each stratum, take held-out first. Allocate 100000 fit inputs proportionally from remaining strata and take next shuffled inputs. Remainder unused. No partial input crosses groups.
dataset.labels: Every compatible complete solution for each selected fit input, matching GRAM expansion; free_counts aggregates the exact full-row PL objective without sampling a completion.
validation: Independent bitmask recursion yields14200 distinct solutions
Direct column/diagonal checks on every solution
Exact set equality against pinned set-based completion recursion
Input-group split disjointness and exact target counts
All selected completion labels represented in exact free-cell counts

fit.objective: sum(solution,cell) free_counts*binary_NLL / sum(free_counts); exactly the expanded2,049,002rowPL objective in real arithmetic.
fit.calibration: tau and delta from all training solution states; temperature unit weighted by their full expanded-row multiplicities.
fit.implementation: Binary Ising fields and exact solution/free-cell sufficient statistics replace redundant two-state/full-row arithmetic. Floating-point reduction order differs; this is declared and independently checked, not claimed bitwise identical.

primary.selection: lowest energy among stopped chains if any, else original lowest-energy return; first-index tie break

search.validation: Search uses learned weights/statistics only. Exact completion set and puzzle rules are evaluation-only.

decision.rule: Support only if exact one-sided95% bound on input fraction with any paired accuracy regression <0.001 and paired-input bootstrap lower coverage difference>-2pp. Falsify if bootstrap upper accuracy difference<-.1pp or upper coverage difference<-2pp; otherwise inconclusive.
decision.bootstrap: 2000 unique-input resamples, retain all three search seeds per input, RNG20261114
decision.secondary: Original output selection, all other frozen checkpoints, N1, stopped/capped counts, per-clue metrics, selector/certificate audits and compute. No setting or checkpoint selected from held-out results.

validation.cpu: Independent complete-solution enumeration plus direct rules; float64 literal full-row two-statePL and gradient versus aggregated binaryPL on a duplicated n12 fixture, atol1e-10/rtol1e-9.
validation.gpu: Before research fits: same full expanded training data loss/gradient comparison against uncompressed upstream OffsetTask at fixed deterministic parameters; absolute loss/gradient error<=1e-5. Three measured forward+backward repetitions after one warmup for each path, no optimizer step or search. Record speed and peak memory.
validation.saved: Exhaustive14200solution membership, givens, original and certificate-first selection identities, per-seed counts, FLOPs, model/data/source hashes.

budget.policy: Workers run on both allocated GPUs with exclusive locks and dynamic pending-job claims. If the envelope is unexpectedly exhausted, retain partial evidence and report incomplete; no silent cap/setting reduction.

limits: New generated n12 split rather than official GRAM benchmark; original n10 hyperparameters transferred without n12 tuning.
Complete solution labels may repeat between disjoint partial inputs, as in the original GRAM protocol; input groups are strictly disjoint.
Clue strata held out contain only6one-clue and305two-clue inputs; primary estimate pools the declared distribution, not equally weighted strata.
One deterministic fitted trajectory per optimizer; repeated inference seeds are not training-seed replication.
Aggregated objective matches the full-row mathematical objective; reordered float32 arithmetic can perturb learned trajectories.
Certificate-first differs from the paper output-selection convention; original-selection results remain separately visible.
